nodes.name: Receive Trigger
nodes.notes:
One-shot. Staff fires this from the dashboard after Second Desktop Review passes. Builds the checklist for the applicant type, saves to DB, emails applicant, then exits.

Uploads and chase are handled separately:
- WF-03b (process document) is called by WF-03b-web (upload portal webhook) and WF-03d (inbox watcher).
- WF-03c chases stale cases daily.

nodes.name: Build Checklist
nodes.notes: Reference checks (referee_1, referee_2) used to be on this checklist but they aren't files — they're contact details and should be on the intake form. Removed.

nodes.name: Postgres: Save Checklist + Set Status

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO car_case_documents (case_id, doc_type, label, category, required, status, created_at)
  SELECT $1, x->>'doc_type', x->>'label', x->>'category', (x->>'required')::boolean, 'pending', now()
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) x
  ON CONFLICT (case_id, doc_type) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE car_cases
SET status = 'documents_pending',
    chase_count = 0,
    last_chase_at = NULL
WHERE case_id = $1
RETURNING case_id, applicant_id, primary_contact_name, primary_contact_email, (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted) AS rows_inserted;

nodes.notes: Parameterised, idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Resets chase state in case the workflow is re-fired.

nodes.name: Build Checklist Email
nodes.notes: EMAIL BUILDER — maps applicant_type → the right document checklist (Individual / Corporate / Fund have different doc lists) and assembles the HTML body of the checklist email including the per-applicant secure upload URL.

nodes.name: Outlook: Send Checklist Email
nodes.notes: INITIAL CHECKLIST EMAIL — sends the document checklist to the applicant via the shared Outlook mailbox. This kicks off WF-03's collection cycle; replies and uploads will be picked up by wf03d_inbox_watcher and wf03b_web_upload respectively.
